change: Two protections added, matching the manager-name verification already used for Job Card Edit / Data Control: (1) Deleting a breakdown now requires typing the manager's name to confirm, not just a Yes/No tap. (2) ETD auto-locks the moment it's set and saved -- shows as read-only with a lock icon, and requires typing the manager's name via a 'Reset ETD' button to unlock and change it again.
